## Description

**What**: Update existing docs that become stale after A1: CLAUDE.md (architecture / quick reference for the phased flow), plugins/dso/README.md (one-command install, flag matrix), KNOWN-ISSUES.md (any A1-specific recovery notes), and docs/designs/create-dso-app-template-contract.md (rewritten contract). Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md.
**Why**: Future agents need accurate awareness of the phased structure, the shared strata-config-defaults file, and the fork's deprecation state.
**Scope**:
- IN: Concise updates to the listed docs; cross-link to strata-config-defaults.conf and strata-template-vars.sh.
- OUT: New documentation files or patterns; restructuring CLAUDE.md beyond targeted updates; per-flag user tutorials.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, CLAUDE.md references the phased structure and the shared strata-config-defaults file
- When complete, plugins/dso/README.md documents the one-command install and CLI flag matrix
- When complete, docs/designs/create-dso-app-template-contract.md is rewritten to reflect the new contract
- When complete, .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md formatting/structure is followed

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Keep updates concise; link to strata-config-defaults.conf and avoid duplicating its contents

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect the create-dso-app.sh phased rewrite and Strata defaults
